teaser: You set two pens down mid-sentence, already chasing a third version of the point before either one is finished. That is a life path 11 crossed with an ENTP: a number asking for a steady channel for its intuition, paired with a type built to multiply possibilities rather than settle one. The 11 wants a single bright signal; the ENTP wants to test every signal against its opposite. What is particular here is the collision between inspired certainty and restless interrogation, both happening in the same breath.
